title: Correct all 127 false
result: Classify the complete emitted dependency types so erased type imports and declared peers are distinguished from dev-only runtime dependencies. Keep warning severity and every other rule unchanged. Six real-detector controls preserve both genuine runtime warnings, including an import resolving to a declaration file. No dependency, lock, path waiver or suppression changed.
evidence: The focused integration test failed with the original rule (five warnings instead of two), then passed after the classification fix. In packages/quality-config, pnpm run lint, pnpm run type-check and pnpm run test --maxWorkers=2 pass: 107 tests across 21 files. Original root pnpm run deps:graph passes with zero violations across 3,698 modules and 5,401 dependencies; pnpm run deps:graph:aliased passes across all six workspaces with no orphans. Full source, installed metadata/links/state, native artifacts and pinned tools retain parity.
